The K2 Horizon model family from IFM represents a comprehensive range of Apache 2.0 licensed models designed specifically for practical local deployment scenarios. With sizes from 0.9B parameters up to 375B, this release addresses a critical gap in the open-source landscape by providing true model diversity that maps to real hardware constraints—from mobile devices and edge servers to high-end workstations and on-premise clusters.

The breadth of this release is significant for practitioners building production systems. Smaller models (0.9B-7B) become viable for edge inference and low-latency requirements, while larger variants enable more sophisticated reasoning tasks on enterprise infrastructure. All models being Apache 2.0 licensed ensures unrestricted commercial use without attribution concerns, a major differentiator for enterprise deployments.

This family enables a pragmatic approach to local LLM infrastructure: teams can benchmark across the full range to find optimal performance-capability tradeoffs for their specific workloads, then quantize and optimize using standard tools like llama.cpp for their target hardware.
